meta.name: render-logo-equation-card
meta.description: Render the logo-equation card ad (7s, 9:16) — partner icon + brand icon joined by a plus sign as an equation, a two-line "= outcome" headline, four numbered steps, and a CTA that hard-cuts in at 2s, on a static black card over timelapse b-roll, no voice. render_card.py draws the two card plates with measured geometry and hard guardrails (the user must confirm the integration is real, no partnership/endorsement/ranking words, no comment-bait CTA, no dashes); compose.py lays the card over the b-roll sped up to read as a timelapse, with an optional bed; measure_motion.py gates the b-roll (a real-time shot reads as a photo). Free, local.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入两个图标与标题,自动合成 7 秒竖版等式卡片广告视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在社媒投放竖版短片广告,又不想每次手动剪辑卡片。
copy.tagline_en: Turn two icons and a headline into a 7-second vertical equation-card ad video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you post vertical short-form ads and don't want to hand-edit each card.

howto.what: 生成 7 秒竖版 9:16 的「logo 等式卡」广告:两个方形图标用加号相连,配两行「= 结果」标题、四个步骤和 2 秒硬切入的 CTA;卡片叠在加速成延时效果的实拍素材上,无配音。render_card.py 按实际尺寸绘制并拦截关系词、破折号等违规文案。
howto.when: 当你要做这种 logo 等式卡广告,并交给它卡片文案(card.json)和实拍素材时接管;它只画 card.json 与参数里写明的内容,示例不是默认值。

say.text: 用我的品牌素材和这份 card.json 渲染一版 logo 等式卡广告
把这段实拍素材加速成延时,铺上卡片,再配一条音乐
用 measure_motion.py 检查这条广告的素材动态是否合格

howto.what_en: Produces a 7s 9:16 logo-equation card ad: two square icons joined by a plus, a two-line "= outcome" headline, four numbered steps, and a CTA cutting in at 2s, on a static black card over timelapse b-roll. No voice.
howto.when_en: Takes over when you want this logo-equation card ad rendered and hand it the card copy (card.json) plus real b-roll; it draws only what card.json and the flags specify, and the demo is not a default.

say_en.text: Render a logo-equation card ad from my brand assets and this card.json
Speed my clip into a timelapse, lay the card over it, add a bed
Run measure_motion.py on the ad to check the b-roll motion
